passed: 800 world layouts are connected, populated and reproducible
Start button is raycastable and invokes the real run
World one starts with zero variable laws, 28 roamers and two guards
Original universal collision damage threshold is retained
Generated world uses fixed destructible trees and visibly giant indestructible rocks
Small stones remain movable ingredients rather than fixed breakable medium obstacles
Real force controller moves the player
Slow walking uses the same real force controller at a lower movement speed
Minimap highlights the actual player position
Heating a moving rock preserves momentum and visibly accelerates below the new speed cap
Same staff impulse: heated rock inflicts at least twice the real collision damage
Cold rock physically rebounds from a thermal static boundary
Launching a creature into a static wall inflicts environmental damage
A real launched stone cannot destroy or move a giant obstacle
The same real launched stone can destroy a fixed tree obstacle
Ordinary enemy shows anticipation before its first collision attack
Anticipation visibly compresses the enemy and locks direction while the player sidesteps
The telegraphed attack releases an actual physics lunge
Heavy guard approaches its physical reach before a visible windup
A heavy guard's telegraphed lunge actually reaches a stationary player and retains collision damage
A real frost projectile freezes generated water into a bridge
Melting occupied ice performs a terrain kill
Vapor recoil triggers at the actual water edge, without placing the center inside water
Vapor recoil applies the spell speed limit immediately, before its next physics contact
A tiny spell remains below fission energy after vapor recoil
Entering steam halves projectile speed once
Hot/cold physical contact releases material-sized lightning damage
Fire still delivers heat after lightning contact equalization
Frost still cools matter after lightning contact equalization
Actual wall collision converts kinetic energy into heat
Abrasion alone heats rough-ground sliding and removes mass
Cold heavy matter attracts a nearby hot light creature
Extreme cold sliding reduces drag to ten percent
Fission works independently: a staff-launched micro rock explodes and damages matter
Shield casts first repel a nearby enemy with real force before any enclosing walls appear
Repelled enemy exits the enclosure before the four cardinal shields finish forming
Shield spell creates four physical cardinal shields
All four shields follow movement without orbiting
A following shield intercepts a real hostile projectile
Own pushed rock can leave the shields, then shield collision is restored
A returning own rock is physically intercepted by the shield instead of permanently passing through it
Thirty seconds of direct fire cannot defeat an elite
Ninety seconds of alternating direct spells, with all laws enabled, removes at most ten percent boss health
Clock cannot upgrade before both fragments are picked up
